\subsection{Units, chemistry and signal processing (19 exports)}
% PUBLIC_EXPORT Quantity
\subsubsection*{Quantity (class)}
\begin{lstlisting}
Quantity(value: 'float', unit_name: 'str')
\end{lstlisting}
A finite real float with a named unit or canonical SI dimensions.
\textit{Audit scope:} Finite real binary floats; no exact or complex quantities. Offset-temperature arithmetic deliberately errors; convert to K first. Unit grammar is named units plus canonical SI products, not a general parser. Equality retains existing absolute tolerance.

% PUBLIC_EXPORT UnitConvert
\subsubsection*{UnitConvert (function)}
\begin{lstlisting}
UnitConvert(qty: 'Quantity', target_unit: 'str') -> 'Quantity'
\end{lstlisting}
Convert a Quantity to a different unit.
\textit{Audit scope:} Finite floating-point conversion; no temperature-difference type or physical absolute-zero validation.

% PUBLIC_EXPORT Element
\subsubsection*{Element (function)}
\begin{lstlisting}
Element(key) -> 'Expr'
\end{lstlisting}
Get element data as an Expr.
\textit{Audit scope:} Embedded 118-element table; audit checks selected known records, not independent verification of every scientific datum.

% PUBLIC_EXPORT AtomicMass
\subsubsection*{AtomicMass (function)}
\begin{lstlisting}
AtomicMass(key) -> 'float'
\end{lstlisting}
Get atomic mass of an element.
\textit{Audit scope:} Embedded rounded atomic masses, not isotope-specific mass data.

% PUBLIC_EXPORT ElectronConfiguration
\subsubsection*{ElectronConfiguration (function)}
\begin{lstlisting}
ElectronConfiguration(key) -> 'str'
\end{lstlisting}
Get electron configuration of an element.
\textit{Audit scope:} Embedded configurations; selected known entries checked, not independent validation of every configuration.

% PUBLIC_EXPORT MolecularMass
\subsubsection*{MolecularMass (function)}
\begin{lstlisting}
MolecularMass(formula: 'str') -> 'float'
\end{lstlisting}
Mass rounded to 0.001 for neutral formulas and parenthesized groups.
\textit{Audit scope:} Neutral formulas and parenthesized groups only; no hydrates, charges, isotope notation or leading coefficients; results round to 0.001.

% PUBLIC_EXPORT BalanceEquation
\subsubsection*{BalanceEquation (function)}
\begin{lstlisting}
BalanceEquation(equation: 'str') -> 'str'
\end{lstlisting}
Balance neutral formulas with unique strictly positive coefficients.
\textit{Audit scope:} Unique strictly positive neutral-formula balances only; ambiguous, impossible, zero-coefficient or pre-coefficient input equations error. No ionic charge conservation.

% PUBLIC_EXPORT FourierTransform
\subsubsection*{FourierTransform (function)}
\begin{lstlisting}
FourierTransform(expr, t_var, w_var) -> 'Any'
\end{lstlisting}
Symbolic Fourier transform using SymPy.
\textit{Audit scope:} SymPy Fourier convention; bounded Gaussian/zero cases do not establish convergence for arbitrary symbolic input. Returned Mikoshi symbols do not encode SymPy assumptions.

% PUBLIC_EXPORT InverseFourierTransform
\subsubsection*{InverseFourierTransform (function)}
\begin{lstlisting}
InverseFourierTransform(expr, w_var, t_var) -> 'Any'
\end{lstlisting}
Symbolic inverse Fourier transform using SymPy.
\textit{Audit scope:} SymPy inverse convention; arbitrary symbolic transforms may remain unevaluated. Returned Mikoshi symbols do not encode SymPy assumptions.

% PUBLIC_EXPORT DFT
\subsubsection*{DFT (function)}
\begin{lstlisting}
DFT(data: 'Expr') -> 'Expr'
\end{lstlisting}
NumPy FFT: negative exponent and no forward normalization.
\textit{Audit scope:} Direct NumPy FFT convention, not Wolfram Session convention. Finite one-dimensional Expr List inputs; bounded samples only.

% PUBLIC_EXPORT IDFT
\subsubsection*{IDFT (function)}
\begin{lstlisting}
IDFT(data: 'Expr') -> 'Expr'
\end{lstlisting}
NumPy inverse FFT: positive exponent with 1/n normalization.
\textit{Audit scope:} Direct NumPy inverse FFT convention; binary floating-point error is expected.

% PUBLIC_EXPORT LowPassFilter
\subsubsection*{LowPassFilter (function)}
\begin{lstlisting}
LowPassFilter(data: 'Expr', cutoff: 'float', sample_rate: 'float' = 1.0, order: 'int' = 5) -> 'Expr'
\end{lstlisting}
Apply a Butterworth low-pass filter.
\textit{Audit scope:} Optional SciPy Butterworth/filtfilt direct-form implementation. Positive integer order and finite positive sample rate required; short inputs and invalid cutoffs error. High-order numerical stability and broad frequency-response accuracy not established.
